title: Fire Scar Shrine

[[File:Fire Scar Shrine.jpg|thumb|The Fire Scar Shrine]]

'''Fire Scar Shrine''' {{coords|26|64|Ashenvale}} is located in southwestern [[Ashenvale]], southwest of [[Astranaar]], south of the [[Shrine of Aessina]], and west of the [[Ruins of Stardust]].

It has been corrupted by the [[demon]]ic influence of the [[Shadow Council]], and is now a place of great evil. A powerful [[orc]]ish [[warlock]], [[Ilkrud Magthrull]], previously resided at the shrine in service to the leader of the [[Cult of the Dark Strand]], [[Athrikus Narassin]]. 

The Shrine is now infested by demons which the [[Adventurer]] is tasked with culling by [[Bolyun]].

A rare [[doomguard]] named [[Akkrilus]] will appear in the shrine's area occasionally.
